title: Addressing Possible Disamenities Such as Indiscriminate Littering and Feeding of Wildlife as Lazarus Island Opens to Eco-Tourism
what_it_is: Addressing Possible Disamenities Such as Indiscriminate Littering and Feeding of Wildlife as Lazarus Island Opens to Eco-Tourism

sections.label: Eco-accommodation rules and biodiversity
sections.summary: The small eco-accommodation holds 15 adults in five units, uses solar power and waste management, and NParks surveys Southern Islands biodiversity.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The scale of the eco-accommodation is small, with a maximum occupancy of 15 adults in five units.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Big Tiny also adopts sustainable practices, such as using solar energy as their main source of power and has in place responsible and appropriate waste management measures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: SDC has worked with and will continue to work with Big Tiny and nature groups to finetune operational best practices.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Should visitors or the operator breach regulations, the relevant agencies will take the appropriate enforcement action.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For example, in terms of biodiversity monitoring, the National Parks Board (NParks) is currently working with various stakeholders to compile the Southern Islands Biodiversity Survey.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: This will cover the terrestrial and marine habitats of all the Southern Islands, including Lazarus Island, and guide its conservation strategies.
